heading: Who is Suryakant Waghmore? IIT-Bombay professor questions faculty protest of dean's removal over student suicide
author: LiveMint Editorial
paragraphs: Suryakant Waghmore, IIT-Bombay sociology professor, has slammed the Faculty Forum for supporting Professor Doolla amid a student suicide case. He argues the forum is imposing pressure on the investigation and questions the appropriateness of their protest following Doolla's removal from deanship.
